_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#22, and it extends the claim. A Neumann condition on a 1-element HEX8 deck is pointed at FUNCT 7 four ways. FUNCT 0 (no function, VAL used directly) exits 0. FUNCT1..FUNCT7 all defined -> index 7 resolves, exit 0, and the answer is bit-identical to the FUNCT-0 arm ('is CORRECT, abs(diff)= 0.00000000000000000e+00'). Defining only FUNCT1 and FUNCT7 and pointing at 7 FAILS with exactly the same text as defining no function at all (GAP_AND_NONE_SAY_THE_SAME=yes): 'Function with index 7 (i.e. input FUNCT7) not available.' from core/utils/src/functions/4C_utils_function_manager.hpp line 110, whose guard is 'functions_.size() < num'. So the index is POSITIONAL — 4C reads FUNCT1, FUNCT2, ... consecutively and stops at the first gap, and a lone FUNCT7 is never read. The throw comes after the input was read and fill_complete() ran twice (GAP_REACHED_FILL_COMPLETE=2) with no parser involvement (GAP_BLAMED_THE_PARSER=0), i.e. at first evaluation, not at parse time. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Function with index 7 (i.e. input FUNCT7) not available.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the GAP arm: give it the full FUNCT1..FUNCT7 run so index 7 is reachable. The not-available diagnostic vanishes, GAP exits 0, and the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the NONE arm: stop referencing a function that was never defined. NONE exits 0 and the fixture must go red.
